question.en: Discuss the role of institutional support in enhancing the efficiency of the agricultural supply chain in India.
question.hi: Discuss the role of institutional support in enhancing the efficiency of the agricultural supply chain in India.

modelAnswer.en: Institutional support via bodies like APEDA, NABARD, and NCDC provides credit, export facilitation, and infrastructure development. These institutions reduce post-harvest losses, improve market access, and ensure financial inclusion for farmers, thereby strengthening the overall agricultural value chain.
